:root{--paper:#fffdf7;--ink:#172b23;--line:#d9ded4;--orange:#bf4a24;--green:#204a37}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);background:#e5e7df;font:15px/1.5 "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:transparent}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #df7c40}main{margin:auto;max-width:440px;height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 0 50px #30453520}header,nav,.row,.spread,.author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.spread,header{justify-content:space-between}header{padding:12px 17px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.brand{font-size:21px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-1.4px;display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}.brand i{font:bold 28px/1 Georgia;background:#ff9b61;padding:4px 6px 0;border-radius:50% 50% 0 50%}.tiny,.series{font:700 10px/1.5 Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:1.2px}.series{color:#626e62}.idSwitch,.soft,.chip{background:#eff0e6;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:12px}.idSwitch{background:#f4e6cf}#app{flex:1;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}nav{justify-content:space-around;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 0 max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}nav button{min-width:110px;font-size:12px;color:#687369;display:grid;justify-items:center}nav .on{color:#1e5036;font-weight:800}nav svg{width:24px;height:24px}h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}h1{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:-1.5px;line-height:1.25}h2{font-size:21px;line-height:1.42;letter-spacing:-.7px}h3{font-size:16px}.pad{padding:16px 17px}.hero{height:clamp(174px,25vh,244px);position:relative;background:#213b2b url("data:image/jpeg;base64,
